commands.review_summary:
The PR updates RunPod acquire, resolve, and release to bind local claims to exact pod id/name identity, require `--reclaim` for unbound or legacy pods, revalidate before termination, and document/test that ownership boundary.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection of current main shows stop uses release-only RunPod resolution, accepts raw provider lookup through `resolvePod`, synthesizes identities for non-Crabbox pod names, and `ReleaseLease` terminates the resulting `CloudID`; no live RunPod mutation was run in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Needs credentialed RunPod live proof and maintainer acceptance of the fail-closed compatibility behavior before merge; there is no narrow automated repair to queue.

target.title: fix: bind RunPod release to exact claims
target.body:
## Summary

- bind RunPod destructive operations to exact local claims containing provider id and pod name
- require explicit `--reclaim` adoption for unclaimed or legacy pods; never silently retarget an existing claim
- re-read the pod under the release lock and verify both id and name before deletion
- reject ambiguous exact, normalized-name, and derived-lease lookups instead of adopting the first provider result
- preserve exact created-pod identity through readiness failure cleanup
- document the ownership boundary

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/801

## Verification

Current candidate: `f860da7eb3fed6a228bff08dfa7b8296ee41c61a`

Local validation on the current candidate:

- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`
- `go test -race ./...`
- `go vet ./...`
- `scripts/check-docs.sh`
- focused RunPod race tests covering mismatch rollback, explicit reclaim, retarget refusal, ambiguous-name/lease refusal, and exact-claim deletion
- full-branch autoreview clean with no accepted/actionable findings

Hosted validation on the current candidate is running.

## Live gate

Blocked pending authenticated RunPod access: no `RUNPOD_API_KEY` or `CRABBOX_RUNPOD_API_KEY` is available in the maintainer environment. Keep this PR unmerged until an exact-head real pod create, SSH command, exact-claim stop, and zero-residue inventory check pass, or that provider-specific gate is explicitly waived.
